outcome: A person can sign in, see a plain error, and sign out
acceptance_criteria: `/sign-in` renders with no `/me` call and no top bar or phone bar. — verify: unit (render `AppShell` at `/sign-in` with a spy fetch: only `GET /api/v1/session` is called); mock (page at `/sign-in` shows the form and no "My work" link).

Desktop and phone layouts match `SCR-17-desktop` and `SCR-17-mobile` for the default state (brand column, headings, labels, "Keep me signed in", "Sign in" button; no "You'll go straight to INV-0412" line, no mobile footer sentence about roles). — verify: mock, design fidelity run at 1440 and 390 wide.
Submitting with an empty field makes no request and shows "Enter your work email." / "Enter your password." — verify: unit (no POST on the fetch spy).
The form has `method="post"`; submitting never changes the address bar to include the password. — verify: unit (attribute) and mock (type a password, press Enter, address stays `/sign-in`).

`POST /session` body is `{username, password, remember, next_url?}` with `remember` a boolean and the `X-CSRFToken` set from the last `GET /session` body. — verify: unit (assert body and header on both checkbox states).

Each error in the table shows exactly the fixed wording, password cleared, username kept, focus on the callout, and no number or time anywhere on the page. — verify: unit with fixtures for 422 `sign_in_failed`, 422 `invalid_input` with `fields`, 403 `csrf_failed`, 429, a thrown network error, 500 and 503; assert the server `message` text never appears; mock with the scenario cookies 429, 503 and 500.
A 403 `csrf_failed` re-reads the token and a second press succeeds without a reload. — verify: unit (second POST carries the new token); mock (use a wrong token via the mock's scenario).
A failed `GET /session` on load shows "We couldn't get sign-in ready" with "Try again" and no form; Try again recovers. — verify: unit.

`safeNext` rejects `https://evil.example`, `//evil.example`, `/\evil.example`, `javascript:alert(1)`, `/%2F%2Fevil.example`, `/api/v1/me`, `/accounts/login/`, `/getting-started/`, `/sign-in`, a value over 2048 characters, an empty string and a non-string; it accepts `/`, `/my-work`, `/projects/P-0101?tab=money`. — verify: unit table test.

`/sign-in?next=%2Fmy-work`: after a good sign-in the browser is at `/my-work`; with `next=https%3A%2F%2Fevil.example` or `next=%2F%2Fevil.example` it ends at `/` then the first destination and never leaves the site, and the POST body has no `next_url`. — verify: unit (router spy) and mock (Playwright).
If the server returns a `next_url` the page would not allow (`/accounts/login/`), the page goes to `/`. — verify: unit.

After a good sign-in as an admitted person the frame shows the new person's name and role words (not the previous person's). — verify: mock (sign in, check the top bar name and `GET /role-dashboard` called again after the sign-in; sign out, sign in as another persona via the DemoBar cookie, name changes); live (criterion 17).

Not admitted: after sign-in as `none` (mock) or `live-none` (live) the page stays on `/sign-in` with "You're signed in, but no work is open to you yet. Ask your administrator." and a working "Sign out"; the browser never loads `/getting-started/`. — verify: unit and live.

Wrong password for the admitted account: the page shows "That email and password don't match." and `POST /api/v1/session` returned 422 `sign_in_failed`. An unknown username returns a byte-identical 422 body and the same page text. — verify: live (browser, plus `curl` through the proxy comparing the two bodies).
Right password: `POST /session` 200, the browser goes to `/`, then the person's first destination, and `GET /api/v1/me` returns 200. — verify: live.

Open redirect: `http://127.0.0.1:3100/sign-in?next=//evil.example` and `?next=https://evil.example` followed by a good sign-in end on a page of the app (never another host); a `curl` `POST /api/v1/session` with `next_url:"//evil.example"` returns a `next_url` that is not `//evil.example`. — verify: live.

Role words: the top bar after sign-in shows the signed-in person's name and the role words from `GET /role-dashboard` without a reload. — verify: live (screenshot of the bar; the network log shows `/me` and `/role-dashboard` after the sign-in).
Signed-in visit: with a session, opening `/sign-in` shows no form and lands on the person's first destination (or the not-admitted message for `live-none`). — verify: live.
Remember: with the box ticked the session cookie has an expiry; unticked it is a session cookie (no `Expires`). — verify: live (`curl -i` through the proxy, `Set-Cookie` for `sessionid`).

Sign-out: from the name menu the browser goes to `/sign-in`, `GET /api/v1/me` then answers 401, and going Back to `/my-work` shows "You're signed out. Sign in" with the link `/sign-in?next=%2Fmy-work`. — verify: live.

Stale token on sign-out: sign in in tab A, sign in again in tab B (rotates the token), press "Sign out" in tab A: the toast "Your session was refreshed. Press Sign out again. Nothing was changed." shows, the person is still signed in (`GET /me` 200), and a second press signs out. Also `curl -X POST .../api/v1/session/logout` with a wrong `X-CSRFToken` returns 403 `csrf_failed`. — verify: live.

Token rotation: the `csrf_token` in the sign-in response differs from the one read before it, and the next write after sign-in (any existing write, e.g. alert settings save) succeeds with the new token. — verify: live (network log).

The top-bar name opens an account menu with "Sign out"; keyboard: Enter opens, arrows move, Esc closes and returns focus to the name, Tab leaves. On a phone the menu has "Sign out" after the destinations. Axe finds no violations on `/sign-in`, the open menu and the error state. — verify: mock (Playwright with `expectNoAxeViolations`, as in `e2e/frame.spec.ts`).
Sign-out failure keeps the person where they are: a 500 or network error shows "We couldn't sign you out. Try again." and the menu still works. — verify: unit.

`grep -rn "accounts/login" frontend/src frontend/tests frontend/e2e` returns only the negative assertion in `tests/next-config.test.ts` and nothing in `src`; every test and e2e spec that asserted `/accounts/login/?next=…` now asserts `/sign-in?next=…` with the same encoded path. — verify: the grep, and `npm test` passing.

The frame's signed-out state (401 from `/me`) shows "You're signed out." with a "Sign in" link to `/sign-in?next=<path>`, and the text "Sign-in opens in a later release" appears nowhere. — verify: unit and mock (`e2e/frame.spec.ts` updated; the old "no link" assertions at lines about 140 and 308 now expect the link).
Forgot password: the page shows the plain sentence, no link or button for it, and no request goes to `/accounts/recovery/*`. — verify: unit (no link by that name, fetch spy) and mock.

The mock answers `POST /api/v1/session` and `POST /api/v1/session/logout` with bodies that validate against the live contract (200, 422 `sign_in_failed`, 403 `csrf_failed`), rotates tokens as in Fixtures, rejects a non-current token, and `GET /me/onboarding` validates too. — verify: unit (extend `tests/mock-live-me.test.ts` pattern with the live 200 and error schemas).
On port 3000 a full round works: sign in with the sample pair, see the frame, sign out, land on `/sign-in`; a wrong pair shows the error. — verify: mock (Playwright `e2e/sign-in.spec.ts`).

risk.rationale: RISK is high. This is sign-in, session and CSRF rotation, and a mistake can expose accounts or lock everyone out (contracts/psl-factory.openapi.json 1.22.0, D-SIGNIN r2, D-AUTH r3). SURFACES are ui, api, auth and security, plus contract-change because the shared `SignedOutState`, the frame's role words and the retired /accounts/login/ links change for about 30 screens. I left out product-decision: the numbers and wording the API cannot supply are bound out of scope above, so no business rule is left to guess. PRODUCT-ACCEPTANCE is required because the flow and its copy are new, and D-173 is an exception, not a client approval. Open backend questions A-46 to A-49, A-54 and A-55 shape copy only and do not block this part.
